name: 20037 · Washington, DC
findings: ZIP 20037 (Washington) has 257 nonprofit organizations. 145 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 135 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20037 (Washington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
